scope: S1 development screening; posture diagnostic thresholds remain descriptive, not a stable-gait pass
metric_definition: Equal weight first-episode metrics; directional speed per episode; count simultaneous per-episode criteria and Wilson 95% interval

criteria.posture: Finite states/actions and actual joint/actuator envelopes are mandatory. Validate posture limits by task and command; signed foot-site projection is a diagnostic proxy, not proof of mesh penetration or a universal turn/strafe failure. Previous 20-degree/1-percent proposal is retained in the planning snapshot, not accepted as a frozen new evaluation rule.
criteria.metric: Planar L2 velocity error per first episode, then equal weight across episodes; never average away a failed command
criteria.posture_threshold_status: Draft only; calibrate by command and valid geometry before freezing

reuse: Reuse only completed, verified 32x20s seed-1001 first-episode traces with identical simulation sources, packages, physical configuration and per-model action/home adapter
selection: Existing final models only. No heldout data or best-checkpoint selection.
